author: Michael Coffin
text:
I've had two sensors FAIL in the past couple of days, by comparison I had not had a sensor failure in many months or over a year!  I noticed they changed something because the display on my iPhone looks slightly different, but I never approved or downloaded an update! :(

PS:  I just assumed everybody was using the latest/greatest Libre 3 Plus, but I see that's not the case so maybe we should indicate what version sensor to see if the problem is unique to one model?  Mine was Libre 3 Plus.
